QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Enhanced Interrogation
QuestInfo.0: The Head Security Officer was sure he could get information out of the Vikings, but things aren't going so hot. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: The Viking prisoners won't say a word. Perhaps more... persuasive methods are needed.
QuestInfo.2: Nothing worked until you threatened to marry them off to Violetta. Her... beauty must be an acquired taste.

0.0: *Sigh* I give up. I'm not sure what kind of training they got, but none of my persuasion methods are working. We must get them to talk.
0.1: Therefore, we must use... ENHANCED interrogation. You may think less of me for this, but I do this for the good of all mushrooms. Can you help?

yes.0: We'll need to use some of the worst enhanced interrogation methods. Prepare yourself. Let's start with the #r#p1302016##k.

no.0: I see. I cannot blame you. Tor-er, enhanced interrogation can be quite cruel.

1.0: T-they started talking? How did you do that? What kind of cruel method did you use? Ehh, nevermind. How do we get onto that airship?

yes.0: A #bdevice hidden near the rear gates#k you can use to get on the airship... I shall file a report with the king right away.

default.0: They are not easy, that's for sure. Our last resort is an ugly one.
